metadata.title: Noteim
metadata.description: Meeting minutes from voice recordings, built for Vietnamese professionals.

app.redirecting: Taking you to the style guide

styleguide.title: Style guide
styleguide.intro: Noteim's colours, type and shapes. Every screen may only use what's on this page.

preview.aiAnswer: Ms Lan plans a 50% loan and is worried about rates after the promo period.

styleguide.previewNote: Lotus pink is what you do, electric violet is what the AI does. The Dawn gradient is only for the record button.
styleguide.colorsHint: Codes and contrast are read from the tokens for the current theme.
styleguide.dawnHint: Only for the record button, the live ribbon glow, and the logo.

bg.name: Page
bg.usage: Porcelain in light, night indigo in dark

senText.name: Lotus text
senText.usage: Pink text on surfaces, playing timestamp

styleguide.tagsHint: Always an icon and a word, never colour alone.
styleguide.speakersHint: Assigned in order of appearance. Only for the ribbon, name dots and transcript bars, never for text.
styleguide.speaker: Speaker {index}
styleguide.typeHint: Large headings use Bricolage Grotesque, everything else uses Be Vietnam Pro.
styleguide.sample: Đặng Thị Quỳnh Ngữ, Nguyễn Hữu Phước: thỏa thuận chuyển nhượng 12,5 tỷ
styleguide.typeDesktopNote: From 768px, Display is 44/52 and H1 is 30/38. Other steps stay the same.
styleguide.spacingHint: Multiples of 4. Page margin is 20px on phones and 32px on desktop.
styleguide.radiusHint: Corners follow hierarchy: the larger the thing, the rounder.

control.name: Control
control.use: Anything you tap or type in

styleguide.shadowHint: Only two shadows. Dark mode uses borders instead.
styleguide.motionHint: Four durations, one curve. Reduced motion turns effects almost off.

components.title: Components
components.hint: Shared building blocks for every screen. Try them.

button.name: Button
button.desc: Five variants. At most one primary button per screen.

record.name: Record button
record.desc: 72 in the navigation bar, 88 on the recording screen. Press the large one.

chips.name: Tags, filters, speakers
chips.desc: Filter chips toggle. Unnamed speakers use secondary text.

row.name: Session row
row.desc: Five library states. A list with dividers, not stacked cards.

bullet.name: Summary point
bullet.desc: Tap a point to play from there. The playing point has a pink bar.
bullet.b1: Needs 2 bedrooms near a primary school

task.name: Task
task.desc: Tap the circle to complete. Unassigned tasks show in amber, never guessed.
task.t1: Send Ms Lan the 50% loan sheet
task.t2: Book a viewing with Ms Lan's husband
task.q1: I'll send you the sheet by tomorrow evening

ai.name: AI block
ai.desc: Electric tint for everything the AI writes.
ai.label: Ask AI
ai.answer: Ms Lan plans a 50% loan and is worried about rates after the promo period. She wants her husband to see the flat before paying a deposit.
ai.error: Couldn't answer that. Your recording is safe.

sheet.name: Sheet
sheet.desc: Close with the button, the backdrop, Esc, or by dragging the handle down.
sheet.body:
Hi Ms Lan, Mr Tuấn,

Here's a summary of this morning: you need a 2-bedroom near a primary school, budget up to 4.2 billion, with a 50% loan. You're still weighing the price against Imperia.

Next: I'll send the loan sheet by 13/11 and book a viewing this week.

toast.name: Toast
toast.desc: Appears at the bottom and closes after a few seconds.
toast.error: Couldn't send to Mr Tuấn. Try again

confirm.name: Confirm dialog
confirm.desc: For actions that can't be undone. The button names what will happen.
confirm.title: Delete originals for 3 sessions?
confirm.lose: Deletes: audio and full transcript (frees 31 MB).
confirm.keep: Keeps: summary, tasks, charts, notes, photos.

banner.name: Banner
banner.desc: Global status under the title bar.
banner.offline: You're offline. Your library is still available.
banner.expiring: Audio will be deleted on 19/11. The summary stays.

empty.name: Empty and loading
empty.desc: Empty screens always invite an action. Skeletons match the shape of what's coming.
empty.message: No sessions yet. Tap the round button below to record your first.

form.name: Inputs, search, switches, tabs
form.desc: Labels sit outside fields. Errors say what to fix.
form.title: Session title
form.emailError: The email needs a domain, for example tuan@company.vn
form.sw1d: Ask every time you start recording
form.pSummary: Key points of the session appear here.
form.pVisual: Charts and diagrams, created when you first open the tab.

ribbon.title: Ribbon
ribbon.hint: Noteim's one signature element. Three forms: thumbnail on session rows, playback inside a session, and live while recording.
ribbon.thumbDesc: 40 bars, 28 high, coloured by speaker. The muted version is for processing or summary-only sessions.
ribbon.playbackDesc: Tap or drag to seek. Keyboard: left and right arrows skip 5 seconds. Dots above are bookmarks, the thin strip below shows each topic's tag.
ribbon.liveDesc: New bars appear on the right and drift left. The glow follows the volume.
ribbon.micDenied: Microphone access is blocked. Allow it in your browser settings, or use the slider.
ribbon.micUnsupported: This browser can't read the microphone. Use the slider.
ribbon.micPrivacy: Only measures volume to draw. Nothing is recorded, stored, or sent.
ribbon.playerDesc: Both versions below share one player, press play on either.
ribbon.momentsDesc: The product's whole motion budget lives here. Reduced motion turns them into fades.
ribbon.m1Desc: The record button blooms into the ribbon and the room goes dark.
ribbon.m2Desc: The ribbon folds into a session row and drops into the library.
ribbon.m3Desc: The ribbon is dyed in each speaker's colour, then the summary points appear.
ribbon.b1: Needs 2 bedrooms near a primary school
ribbon.b3: Wants her husband to see it before the deposit

shell.offline: You're offline. Your library is still available.
shell.soon: This part comes in a later step of the mockup.

library.empty: No sessions yet. Tap the round button below to record your first.
library.quotaOut: You've used all {limit} minutes this month. New minutes arrive on {date}.
library.pickOne: Pick a session to see its summary.

session.expiring: Audio will be deleted on {date}. The summary stays.
session.essence: Only the summary remains for this session. Audio can't be played.
session.noTasks: No tasks were assigned in this session.
session.saveError: Couldn't save. Check your connection and try again.
session.notFound: Couldn't find this session. It may have been deleted.
session.processing: Summarising this session, step {step}/5. You can leave this screen.
session.failed: Couldn't summarise this session. The recording is safe.
session.unsynced: This session is waiting for a network connection to upload. The recording is safe on this device.
session.soonTab: This tab comes in a later step of the mockup.

record.permissionBody: Noteim only measures loudness to draw the voice ribbon while you record. No audio is stored or sent anywhere.
record.micDeniedHint: The microphone is not allowed. Turn on mic permission in your browser settings and try again.
record.micUnsupportedHint: This browser cannot read the microphone.
record.consentTitle: Has everyone agreed to be recorded?
record.announcing: Playing: This meeting is being recorded for minutes
